resources.string: Hold Home. The system gives Scanify a screenshot of the current screen, and Scanify opens Google Lens with it. Android 11 or newer.
Voice session: not selected — retap Set as assistant
Tap Set as assistant to open the system assistant settings. Choose Scanify under Digital assistant app; the Voice session line should read selected.
The screenshot is shared directly to the installed Google Lens app.
How to test the voice path
The screenshot is saved in Scanify cache and shared only with Lens. Scanify does not upload anything.
Hold Home to test. The system opens Scanify\'s voice session and hands it the screenshot.
MIUI launched the activity path, not the voice session. Check Scanify\'s Voice session setting.
Voice session ran, but the system did not send a screenshot.
Tap to reselect Scanify as the digital assistant.
